study.title: Learning
study.offTitle: Study room – IRIS learns from your translations
study.offText: Paste an original and its verified translation, for example from a technical book. IRIS pairs the sentences, you check them, and IRIS learns your field from them and from your corrections. Everything stays on this computer, and what IRIS learned is used only when it passes a check.
study.note: IRIS learns only from the verified translation and your corrections – never from another translator.
